zh: 蓮心小築的清晨。一封戰帖，比太陽來得還早。
洛先生，魏無憂托我送來的，說是十年之約，今日了斷。
他托你送？他該知道，你的嘴，比信封還要漏風。
嘿嘿，所以整個江湖，現在都知道了。
那就好。這場決鬥，本來就是要給人看的。
給那些，想看我們互相殘殺的人。孤鴻，萬佛峰下，你在暗處。
萬佛峰下。魏無憂等這一天，已經等了十年。
洛無塵！你約我在這裡，人呢？
魏兄，十年不見，你的刀，還是這麼急。
少廢話。十年前那一戰，你讓了我三招。今天，我要你一招都不讓！
無塵沒有讓你。那一戰，是無塵輸了。
你輸了，我卻從來沒覺得我贏過！這就是我最恨你的地方！
那今天，就讓魏兄，好好地贏一次。
白日看人笑，黑夜看人哭；
天下最樂事，看你們互相毒。
陰陽郎君。閣下也是來看熱鬧的？
看熱鬧？不不不。本郎君是來，請兩位看一場更熱鬧的。
她呀，是門票。你們兩個，打一場給本郎君看。
打得好看，我就放了她。打得不好看……
那就只好，讓她陪本郎君，看下一場了。
那她現在就死。哈哈哈！天下最好看的，就是正人君子，為了救人，不得不互相殘殺！
魏兄等了十年。那就，不必再等了。
怎麼停了？本郎君還沒看夠！
哈……哈哈！演的？你們兩個，竟然是演給我看的！
……連人都被搶走了。洛無塵，你從一開始，就沒打算陪我玩。
郎君的遊戲，無塵陪過了。只是規矩，要由下棋的人定。
哈哈哈！有意思，這個江湖，越來越有意思了！
下一次，本郎君會找一個，連你都算不到的遊戲。
你剛才那一劍，是真的想殺我。
魏兄會躲開的。無塵算過。
……你什麼都算。連我會怎麼躲，你都算好了。
洛無塵，我討厭你，就是因為你什麼都算得到。
那魏兄可知道，無塵算不到的是什麼？
是人心。每一次，都是人心。
……下次，我們真的打。不演戲，不算計。
（陰陽郎君只愛看戲……可今天這場戲，又是誰，在台下看著我們？）
出來吧。站在樹後面看了一整場戲，腿不酸嗎？
千面鏡王。你那張借來的臉，戴得累不累？
郎君說笑了。本王今日，戴的是自己的面具。
是嗎？那龍淵閣上，喝下那杯酒的，又是誰的臉？
別緊張。本郎君不會說出去的。
說出去，戲就不好看了。我要看著你們，一個一個，把自己騙死。哈哈哈哈！
（這個瘋子……總有一天，本王要戴上你的臉。）
沒有。他一路上都在笑，笑得我渾身發冷。
他還說了一句奇怪的話。他說：「妳知道嗎？妳身上的劍譜，是有人故意讓妳帶出來的。」
我師父死的那一夜，是誰把消息透露給血蓮的？我一直以為是巧合。
江湖上，沒有那麼多巧合。
兩位，有一個消息，免費送你們！
你錢不二，也有免費的消息？
因為這個消息，我賣不出去——沒有人敢買！
有人在太虛峰下，看見了血蓮的旗子。還有……一個本來應該已經死了的人。
燕姑娘，妳師父遇害的那一夜，血蓮來得太準了，是不是？
那一夜透露消息的人，和在大會上換掉慧明的人，是同一個人。
他要劍譜離開妳師父的手，又要它離開妳的手。他一直在等，等它走到一個……他拿得到的地方。
夜無極若真的回來了，第一個要找的，是太虛峰。我去。
凌少俠，萬事小心。這一次的夜無極……也許已經不是人了。
武林之下，是另一個世界。那裡沒有日月，只有火。
你墜下雲海的時候，是本帝，接住了你的魂。
現在，本帝給你，第二條命。
帝君。本尊這條命，從今以後，就是帝君的。
去吧。去太虛峰。讓那些人知道，幽冥的影子，回來了。
帝君，那殷九霄與千面鏡王，真的可信？
殷九霄以為，他在利用鏡王。鏡王以為，他在利用殷九霄。
他們都不知道，他們只是在替本帝，把兩卷天機策，送到一處。
凌雲霄……這一次，本尊要你親眼看著，你所守護的，一一毀滅。
魔影重臨，太虛峰上，風雲將變。
en: Morning at the Lotus Heart Retreat. A challenge arrived before the sun did.
Master Luo, Wei Wuyou asked me to bring this. He says: the ten-year promise, settled today.
He sent you? He ought to know your mouth leaks worse than any envelope.
Hee hee — which is why the whole world knows about it now.
Good. This duel was always meant to be watched.
By those who want to see us kill each other. Gu Hong — below the Peak, keep to the shadows.
Below the Peak of Ten Thousand Buddhas. Wei Wuyou has waited ten years for this day.
Luo Wuchen! You named this place — where are you?
When the lotus opens, all under heaven is still;
between half a smile and the next, the game is won.
Brother Wei. Ten years, and your blade is as impatient as ever.
Enough talk. Ten years ago you gave me three moves. Today you give me none!
Wuchen gave you nothing. That fight — Wuchen lost.
You lost — and I never once felt I had won! That is what I hate about you most!
Then today, let Brother Wei win properly, once.
By day I watch men laugh, by night I watch them weep;
the sweetest thing under heaven is to watch you poison each other.
The Yin-Yang Gentleman. Have you come for the show as well?
For the show? No, no, no. I have come to give you two a better one.
Yan Feishuang? What do you want with her?
She? She is the price of a ticket. You two — fight for me.
Fight well, and I let her go. Fight badly...
then she will have to keep me company for the next show.
And if Wuchen will not fight?
Then she dies now. Ha ha ha! There is nothing so fine to watch as good men forced to kill each other to save a life!
Brother Wei has waited ten years. He need wait no longer.
Lotus Sword Light: Three Thousand Worlds!
Why have you stopped? I haven’t seen nearly enough!
Lotus Sword Light: Three Thousand Worlds!
Ha... ha ha! An act? The two of you were acting for me!
...You’ve even taken her back. Luo Wuchen — you never meant to play my game at all.
Wuchen has played your game, sir. Only the rules are set by the one who moves the pieces.
Ha ha ha! How amusing — this world grows more amusing every day!
Next time I will find a game even you cannot see coming.
That cut of yours just now — you truly meant to kill me.
If it had not been true, it would not have fooled him.
And if I had not dodged it?
Brother Wei would dodge it. Wuchen had worked it out.
...You work everything out. Even how I would dodge — you had it worked out.
Luo Wuchen, I hate you precisely because you can foresee everything.
Then does Brother Wei know what it is that Wuchen cannot foresee?
Men’s hearts. Every time, it is men’s hearts.
...Next time, we fight for real. No acting. No scheming.
(The Gentleman only loves a show... but today’s show — who else was in the audience, watching us?)
Come out. You watched the whole show from behind that tree — aren’t your legs tired?
The Mirror King. That borrowed face of yours — doesn’t it get tiring to wear?
You jest, sir. Today this king wears his own mask.
Is that so? Then on the night of the council — whose face was it that drank that cup?
Relax. I shan’t tell a soul.
If I told, the show would be spoiled. I want to watch every one of you lie yourselves to death. Ha ha ha ha!
(That madman... one day this king will wear your face.)
No. He laughed the whole way. It made my skin crawl.
And he said something strange. He said: “Do you know? Someone meant for you to carry that manual out.”
The night my master died — who told the Blood Lotus where we were? I always thought it was chance.
In this world, there are not so many chances.
You two — a piece of news, free of charge!
Qian Bu’er gives away news for free?
Because nobody will buy this one — they’re all too scared!
Someone saw the banner of the Blood Lotus below Void Peak. And... a man who ought to be dead.
Miss Yan — the night your master was killed, the Blood Lotus came far too surely, didn’t they?
You think so too, Master Luo?
Whoever gave you away that night is the same one who took Huiming’s place at the council.
He wanted the manual out of your master’s hands, and then out of yours. He has been waiting all this while for it to arrive somewhere... where he can reach it.
Beneath the seals of the Three Teachings.
If Ye Wuji truly is back, the first place he will go is Void Peak. I’ll go.
Young Master Ling, take every care. The Ye Wuji who comes this time... may no longer be a man.
Beneath the martial world lies another. There is no sun there, no moon — only fire.
When you fell into the sea of clouds, it was I who caught your soul.
And now I give you a second life.
The blood lotus opens again, and ten thousand bones run dry;
back from the Nine Netherworlds, I am the slaughter.
My Emperor. From this day, this life of mine is yours.
Go. Go to Void Peak. Let them know the shadow of the Netherworld has returned.
My Emperor — Yin Jiuxiao and the Mirror King: can they truly be trusted?
Yin Jiuxiao believes he is using the Mirror King. The Mirror King believes he is using Yin Jiuxiao.
Neither knows that both of them are only carrying the two halves of the Stratagem to one place — for me.
Ling Yunxiao... this time I will make you watch everything you protect destroyed, one by one.
The demon’s shadow returns, and on Void Peak the winds are about to turn.
